title: Why estimates of the Luzon Strait transport and Kuroshio intrusion differ
query: Published estimates of the Luzon Strait transport and of the seasonality and forms of Kuroshio intrusion into the South China Sea differ widely. Using the supplied CMOMS daily velocity, temperature and salinity for 2011-2020, quantify the Luzon Strait transport (mean, seasonal cycle, vertical structure and variability) and the frequency and forms of Kuroshio intrusion, compare them with published estimates, and diagnose why estimates differ.
